title: Delaware (DE) Counties
text:
Delaware (DE) Counties

FIPS codes for Delaware.

FIPS State Code: 10 

Enter the U.S. country code (01) followed by the state and county code.

For example, for Kent County, enter 
01-10001.

| FIPS County Code | County Name |
| --- | --- |
| 001 | Kent |
| 003 | New Castle |
